properties.name: NON_TOOL_TERMS gains the SCHEDULED_FOR / DesignEpoch / GATED_ON vocabulary the new plan-increments skill names — modality, expected, required, achieved, sequence, kind, min_level, deployed, unreleased_component. The lint's own failure message asks for exactly this, in the same diff. No design meaning: the allowlist is how the lint distinguishes a field name from a mistyped tool, and adding the terms a new skill legitimately uses carries no claim about the design.
